=SELECT 
  d.id AS draft_id,
  d.idea_id,
  d.keyword_cluster_id,
  d.title,
  d.meta_title,
  d.meta_description,
  d.tags,
  d.content_markdown,
  d.content_html,
  d.word_count,
  d.featured_image_url,
  d.wordpress_media_id,
  d.featured_image_alt,
  d.featured_image_prompt,
  d.wordpress_post_id,
  d.wordpress_post_url,
  d.status AS draft_status,
  d.approved_at,
  d.approved_by,
  i.idea_title,
  i.categoria,
  k.cluster_name,
  k.keyword_principal,
  k.keywords_secundarias,
  k.project_name
FROM drafts d
LEFT JOIN ideas i ON i.id = d.idea_id
LEFT JOIN keywords k ON k.id = d.keyword_cluster_id
WHERE d.id = '{{ $json.body.draft_id }}'
  AND d.status IN ('approved', 'review')
LIMIT 1

=UPDATE drafts
SET 
  wordpress_post_id = {{ $json.wordpress_post_id }},
  wordpress_post_url = '{{ $json.wordpress_post_url }}',
  published_at = NOW(),
  status = 'published',
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.draft_id }}'
RETURNING id, wordpress_post_id, wordpress_post_url, published_at, status

=UPDATE scheduled_publications
SET 
  status = 'published',
  wordpress_post_id = {{ $items('Extraer Datos WordPress', 0)[0].json.wordpress_post_id }},
  wordpress_post_url = '{{ $items('Extraer Datos WordPress', 0)[0].json.wordpress_post_url }}',
  published_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE draft_id = '{{ $items('Extraer Datos WordPress', 0)[0].json.draft_id }}'
  AND status = 'pending'
RETURNING id, draft_id, status, published_at

=INSERT INTO jobs_log (
  job_name,
  job_type,
  status,
  started_at,
  completed_at,
  duration_ms,
  input_data,
  output_data) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.job_name }}',
  '{{ $json.job_type }}',
  '{{ $json.status }}',
  '{{ $json.started_at }}',
  '{{ $json.completed_at }}',
  {{ $json.duration_ms || "NULL" }},
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.input_data) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.output_data) }}'::jsonb)
RETURNING id, job_name, status, completed_at
